env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
env.description: Canonical public URL of the site, no trailing slash. Falls back to the url in site.config.ts

providers.description: Client providers contributed by modules, outermost first.

body-end.description: Components rendered at the end of <body> (analytics, consent banners, toasters).

header-actions.description: Components rendered in the site header next to the theme toggle (sign-in, cart …).

next-plugins.description: next.config wrappers (Sentry, next-intl …). Generated into src/generated/next.ts.

proxy.type: (request: NextRequest, response: NextResponse) => Response | undefined | Promise<Response | undefined>
proxy.description: Request handlers run by src/proxy.ts in order. Set cookies/headers on `response` and return nothing to continue, or return a Response to stop.
